name: script-progress-dashboard
description: Real-time progress tracking and operations dashboard for long-running scripts. Reads JSON files your scripts write; no network, no AI, no dependencies.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Quick Action buttons run shell commands defined in settings. In an untrusted workspace, buttons defined by the workspace's own settings are ignored and no command is run.

scriptProgress.logsPath.description: Folder holding progress.json, run_history.json, deltas.json and access.json. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder; absolute paths are used as-is.

scriptProgress.refreshInterval.description: Fallback poll interval in milliseconds. File changes are also picked up immediately by a watcher; this catches anything the watcher misses.

scriptProgress.staleRunningMinutes.description: If progress.json still says 'running' but has not been updated for this many minutes, the task is shown as STALLED (the script probably died without reporting).

scriptProgress.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the current task in the VS Code status bar.

scriptProgress.sections.activeTask.description: Show the Active Task progress section.

scriptProgress.sections.warnings.description: Show the Warnings section (hidden automatically when there are none).

scriptProgress.sections.lastCompleted.description: Show the Last Completed metric cards.

scriptProgress.runHistory.maxRows.description: Maximum rows to show in Run History.

scriptProgress.sections.processCalendar.description: Show the Process Calendar (expected daily / weekly / monthly processes and whether they have run).

scriptProgress.processCalendar.processes.description: Expected processes. 'name' is matched against the START of task names in run history, case-insensitively.

name.description: Prefix of the task name to match in run history (e.g. 'Nightly Load' matches 'Nightly Load Phase 2').

dayOfMonth.description: Monthly only: the day by which the process is expected. Overdue after this day if it has not run this month.

scriptProgress.sections.quickActions.description: Show Quick Action buttons that run commands in a terminal.

scriptProgress.quickActions.buttons.description: Buttons. In 'command', write ${prompt:Your question} anywhere you want to be asked for a value when the button is clicked.

command.description: Shell command sent to a terminal. ${prompt:Label} tokens ask for input first.

group.description: Group heading the button appears under.

scriptProgress.sections.deltaTracker.description: Show the Delta Tracker sparkline charts.

scriptProgress.deltaTracker.metrics.description: Metric names from deltas.json to chart. Empty = chart every metric present.

scriptProgress.sections.scriptHealth.description: Show Script Health: last run per task with stale detection.

scriptProgress.scriptHealth.staleHours.description: Hours after which a task with no run is considered stale (default 7 days).

scriptProgress.sections.accessMap.description: Show the Access Map: which scripts touch which files, tables and services, drawn as a 2D constellation in the dashboard tab.

scriptProgress.accessMap.maxNodes.description: Cap on nodes drawn in the Access Map (least recently seen are dropped first).
